title: Dragon's Riddle Bridge
description: A hooded figure in a dark cloak stands on the left holding a large quill, facing an enormous black dragon perched on a stone bridge made of parchment. The dragon's wings are spread wide as it breathes speech bubbles containing letters and words, while the bridge is covered in glowing text, floating books, and small illuminated cards above a dark river.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene of a hooded figure with a giant quill standing before a massive black dragon perched on an ancient stone bridge constructed from glowing parchment covered in text. The dragon has large wings and glowing orange eyes, speech bubbles with letters emerging from its mouth. Floating books, illuminated cards, and magical particles fill the air. Stormy sky with bats and a distant castle on a cliff. Moody cinematic lighting, rich details, fantasy illustration style.
